connector.name: Bee - The Progressive Intelligence Engine
connector.registryDescription: Bee - The Progressive Intelligence Engine: tiered LLM, 4 tools, hosted API, free tier.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package bee-sdk. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cuilabs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BEE_API_KEY
env.description: Bee API key (bee_sk_…). Create one at https://bee.cuilabs.io/app/account/api-keys — the free Cell tier works.

env.name: BEE_MODEL
env.description: Default model tier (bee-cell … bee-swarm). Tier access follows the API key's plan. Default: bee-cell (free).

env.name: BEE_API_URL
env.description: Override the gateway base URL (default https://bee.cuilabs.io/bee). Set only for a self-hosted Bee Enclave or staging.
